     OPENAI
    AI instrumentation
    
      
    The model adds execution probes and suggests a view. The instrumented code then runs in your browser. This sends your source code to OpenAI.
    
      
      
      
      
      
    
    
    
      

  
    
     STUDIO GUIDE
    Follow an execution
    
    
      
      
    1. Enter a LeetCode problem URL or number to load a reference solution, or paste a self-contained Python or C++ program.
      2. 
      
    2. Add any standard input, then run the trace. Python records executed lines and C++ uses probes inserted into typical braced C++17 code.
      3. 
      
    3. Scrub the timeline or press the left and right arrow keys to step. Use Space to play or pause when focus is outside the editor.
      4. 
      
    4. Use Cinema for the call tree and live memory. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, or open Watch for variables, steps, and output.
      5. 
    
    
    
    Recording is capped at 1,500 steps. Code continues running within the time limit so its result is available in Output. Run C++ with a main() and paste any sample input under Program input. To place a C++ probe manually, add CINE(line, "scope", "label", SHOW(variable)); after a statement.
